text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu, an Umamusume who stands out 
distinctly even within the prestigious 
Mejiro family. She loves racing more 
deeply than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At her debut press conference, she boldly 
declared her intent to achieve history's 
first Triple Tiara sweep, drawing fervent 
expectations from the press corps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she pays no heed to the expectant 
gazes. To prove her love for racing 
through total victory, she focuses 
entirely on honing her own craft.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer pledges in their heart to 
carve out the future of racing together 
with Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To that end, I want to match her stride. 
To run a race that is nothing short of 
absolute perfection.
